archLegend.dialogDescription: What the colours, markers and symbols of this view mean.
archLegend.intro: On this page colour stands for status and nothing else. Artifact type, level and version are told apart by text and position — they stay deliberately neutral.
archLegend.statusHint: The status is set in the element header and is the only colour-coded information.
archLegend.statusApprovedMeaning: Binding and ready for a baseline.
archLegend.lifecycleHint: Independent of the approval status. The filter above the list works on this field; deleted elements are not shown at all.
archLegend.lifecycleActive: Valid part of the current architecture.
archLegend.lifecycleOutdated: Still present but superseded — kept visible for traceability.
archLegend.lifecycleDeprecated: No longer used, kept for existing links.
archLegend.levelHint: The level is the real depth in the architecture tree, not a fixed list — it grows with the decomposition. A level is not a state, which is why the marker in the header is neutral. In the navigation tree on the left the same marker is additionally coloured by depth; that colour is a legacy rendering and carries no status meaning.
archLegend.level1: Direct decomposition of the root, e.g. subsystems.
archLegend.levelN: Every further decomposition step, e.g. components and their parts.
archLegend.identifier: Identifier of the element, always in a monospaced font. Clicking the identifier in the header copies it.
archLegend.version: Current revision. Kept neutral — a version is not a status. Older revisions appear dimmed and without a border.
archLegend.spineHint: The strip above the form shows where the element is derived from and what follows from it.
archLegend.spineHere: The station the currently opened element sits on.
archLegend.spineCount: Number of artifacts on this station, or of the linked test cases. Clicking opens the list.
archLegend.spineEmpty: A link is missing on this station — a gap in traceability.
